name: Reassign REST API
description:
The public REST API for Reassign, the 24-hour circular day planner. It exposes the same engine the MCP server uses: read a day, create and move events, place work into free time, reflect on a past day, log moments against trackers, and manage areas, activity types, and the Inbox.

Public endpoints need a Bearer token, or the signed-in app session cookie, and generally Reassign Pro access. The 7-day free trial includes Reassign Pro. App-only projections instead require the session cookie, as marked on each operation. A token is either a Personal Access Token (`rsk_live_…`) or an OAuth 2.1 access token minted for the `https://reassign.app/api/v1` resource. Reads need the `events:read` or `events:write` scope. Write access includes read access; writes need `events:write`.

A span is `start` + `end`, two local datetimes "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" (no seconds, offset or Z) in the account's time zone, which a response names once as the top-level `timezone`. The end is after the start; an overnight or multi-day event simply ends on a later day. Dates are ISO "YYYY-MM-DD" and instants are ISO 8601 UTC strings. One occurrence of a recurring event has the composite id `seriesId@YYYY-MM-DD`, and a bare series id addresses the whole series; `scope: "future"` on an occurrence id also edits every later occurrence.

A path that no route serves, for example a removed route, first applies the same auth check, then answers 404 `not_found` "No API route has this path."; a Chrome extension build before 1.2.0 gets 422 `validation` "Update the Reassign extension to 1.2.0." in its place.
